chapters.title: Transition to AI at Work Roadmap
AI at Work Roadmap Features and Filters
Downloading Roadmap Data and MCP Integration

features.name: AI at Work Roadmap
features.description: New unified destination for all Microsoft product release information replacing Business Central release plans. Provides centralized location for developers and partners to track upcoming features across all Microsoft products.
caveats: Details available on roadmap items may be less comprehensive than previous release plans

features.name: Release Plan Discontinuation
features.description: Microsoft stopped publishing detailed Business Central release plans starting with version 2026 release wave 2. Existing release plans remain available for historical reference.
caveats: Historical release plans will remain available
This impacts documentation and reference materials

features.name: Copilot Agent Capabilities - Run Data Queries with MCP Server
features.description: Copilot agent feature announced with version 29 enabling running data queries with MCP server, rolled out in October 2026.

features.name: Dynamics 365 Business Central Expense Agent - Withholding Taxes
features.description: Expense agent receiving update for calculating withholding taxes in expense reports. Preview available October 2026 with CU0 or CU1, rollout starting April 2027.

features.name: Roadmap CSV Export
features.description: Ability to download roadmap data as CSV file for offline use in Excel or import into Business Central environment for sharing with team members.

features.name: MCP Server Integration for Roadmap
features.description: MCP server connection enabling IT admins, engineers and technical users to query release and roadmap information directly in AI clients like Visual Studio Code and GitHub Copilot without relying on website.

features.name: Business Central Release Schedule
features.description: Business Central continues to deliver two major releases every year and monthly minor updates as before, maintaining established release cadence.

features.name: Roadmap Version Numbering and Wave Terminology Evolution
features.description: Microsoft expects to continue with update version numbers but wave terminology will likely evolve. More details will be shared as plans are finalized.
caveats: Subject to change as plans finalize
